dialog: There's a problem with this formula. 
Not trying to type a formula?
When the first character is an equal ("=") or minus ("-") sign, Excel thinks it's a formula:

• you type:   =1+1, cell shows:   2

To get around this, type an apostrophe ( ' ) first:

• you type:   '=1+1, cell shows:   =1+1 |

dialog: There are one or more circular references where a formula refers to its own cell either directly or indirectly. This might cause them to calculate incorrectly.  
Try removing or changing these references, or moving the formulas to different cells. |

Do you want to accept this correction? | This is an incomplete formula. It has an operator, like + or -, not followed by an operand. Try one of the following: 
• Add the missing operand to the formula, or delete the extra operator.
